nom: florence by mills Pore Power To You Deep Cleansing Pore Strips

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily/acne-prone skin generally report the strips remove blackheads and excess oil without stripping the skin, though one oily-skin reviewer found the strips would not stick well.
segments.dry: One reviewer with normal/dry skin found the strips left her nose and chin somewhat flaky after use.
segments.combination: A reviewer with oily-to-combo skin said the strips did little beyond reducing oiliness and left her skin burning and dry.
segments.sensitive: A reviewer who identifies as having very sensitive skin experienced chin irritation lasting a few hours, though the strips did not worsen her acne.
segments.mature: One reviewer states the strips can be used on 'old or younger skin,' suggesting suitability across ages, but no dedicated mature-skin outcome is described in detail.

concerns.aging: Only a single passing mention notes the product works for 'old or younger skin'; no other aging-specific outcomes are reported.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the strips leave skin soft, smooth or moisturized rather than dry, but a few describe flakiness, dryness, stinging or burning afterward.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers explicitly note no redness or irritation after use, while others report tingling, burning, or irritation, including one who found her nose reddened less than with other brands.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers mention concern about strips stripping natural oils or moisture, but most who tried them said their skin did not feel stripped or tight afterward.
concerns.spots: Reviewers with acne-prone skin report the strips helped clear breakouts and faded acne scars on the chin, though results on the nose were sometimes described as less noticeable.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report visible removal of blackheads and whiteheads, especially on the nose; a minority say almost nothing came out or blackheads remained.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers with oily skin report the strips absorbed excess oil and reduced shine without over-drying, though one reviewer felt it only reduced oiliness without pulling much debris.

aspects.libelle: Strip loses adhesion or falls off

extraits.texte: I received this product as sample for the #florencepanel. These pore strips are unbelievably adorable but they don't do too well. I used them a couple of times and almost nothing came off of them. I have oily to combo skin and these didn't really help other than make my skin less oily. These strips left my skin burning and dry.

extraits.titre: Wasn't the best for my skin
extraits.texte: | was provided a free sample as part of the #florencepanel by florence by mills to try the product and write an honest review. After using this product I did not notice many differences in my skin. It didn't make my acne worse but it did irritate my chin for a few hours after using, this could just me because I have very sensitive skin but I overall I don't think this product is the best for me

I was kindly gifted a free sample of this product as a member of #FLORENCEPANEL by florence by mills when I tried the product for the first time I was impressed with the outcome, my pores were less visible and my oily skin was at bay. My skin is oily so when I normally use products like this my skin will be stripped or feel tight but this was not the case I will definitely be buying again!

This is my review on being part of the #FLORENCEPANEL. I was sent a free sample by Florence by Mills to review their product honestly. The Pore Power To You Deep Cleansing Pore Strips is a good product but I would hold off on getting them again. After removing the strips off of my nose & chin, they did remove just about almost everything. But the downside that I have on this product is it left my nose & chin a but flaky. Since my skin is normal / dry.

extraits.titre: Great for oily acne prone skin
extraits.texte: I have found that these do a better job for my oily, acne prone skin. I have constant issues with blackheads and I leave these on for 20+ mins and they do a way better job than any other brand I've tried. Just make sure to leave it on 20-30 mins instead of 10-15mins. It will pull out all the gunk!

I was provided a free sample as part of the #florencepanel by florence by mills to try the product and write an honest review. I used these strips on my chin and within days my acne scars started to fade away. I would say that when I did place the strip on my nose I didn't really see a difference, and it also wouldn't stay on my nose but other than that it worked on my chin where I tend to break out.

extraits.titre: Florenece Power to you deep pore strips
extraits.texte: I dont normally use pore strips mostly because I heard it hurts and strips your skin of oil leaving skin dry but these strips felt very moisturizing and didn't really hurt and all. I was given a free sample as a part of #FLORENCEPANEL
